decisions.reason: The MMAK modular concept is backed by a quantified customer result of more than 600,000 euros in yearly savings, which exceeds aspirations and justifies keeping it as a strategic system offering.
The mobile slow-speed shredder belongs to the firm's core competence and has had its own page for two years, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
This MMAK entry is supported by a named reference customer and documented savings, which signal results above aspiration and a reason to continue.
The newly launched slow-speed shredders extend the firm's established core line, and their results are still uncertain, so slack in the core business lets the firm carry them.
The mobile spiral shaft screens are too new to judge against aspirations, and they fill the screening gap left by the dropped trommel, so management gives them time.
